title: Show HN: Posthorn, self-hosted mail without the mail server
summary: Posthorn is a self-hosted email gateway that solves the common problem of VPS providers blocking SMTP ports. It provides a single Docker container or Go binary that acts as a relay between self-hosted applications and transactional email providers, eliminating the need to configure complex Postfix setups.
problem_solved: VPS providers like DigitalOcean blocking default SMTP ports prevents self-hosted applications from sending transactional emails without complex configuration.
why_valuable: It provides a simple, one-time setup solution that replaces complex Postfix relay configurations with a single container deployment.
